targets.query:
from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_stats" and r._field == "cpu_percent")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_stats" and r._field == "mem_usage")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_stats" and r._field == "mem_percent")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_stats" and r._field =~ /net_(rx|tx)/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_stats" and r._field == "pids")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_container" and r._field == "size_bytes")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["state"])
  |> count(column: "_value")
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "containers"})
  |> keep(columns: ["state", "containers"])

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_image" and r._field == "size_bytes")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 8)
  |> keep(columns: ["ref", "_value"])

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_connection" and r._field == "inode")
  |> group(columns: ["container", "state"])
  |> count(column: "_value")
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "connections"})
  |> keep(columns: ["container", "state", "connections"])

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_network" and r._field == "containers")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["name", "driver", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {name: "network", _value: "containers"})

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_conn_count")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "connections")

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: -4m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "docker_connection" and r._field == "endpoint")
  |> group(columns: ["container", "protocol", "state"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["container", "protocol", "state", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "endpoint"})
  |> sort(columns: ["container", "state"])

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "collector_run" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "duration_s")

from(bucket: "docker")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "collector_run" and r._field == "points")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "points")
